items.rationale: One travel charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f); priced at the reference level of about 81.
Sealing and consumable installation material is a necessary repair cost under 7.1.7(c); case 39 showed at least 24.
Like-for-like replacement of the failed pipe section; reference level about 40 per m.
Insulation that formed part of the installation is covered under 7.1.7(c); about 23 per m.

Installer labour is covered under 7.1.7(g), but one hour of installation is a small job. Case 39 had installer hours at 76 or more, so a customary hourly rate applies rather than the AC-unit installation price level.
Trade labour is covered under 7.1.7(g); case 39 showed 9 hours at 732 or more.
Drying is covered under 7.1.7(b) and a flat-rate deployment once per drying operation under 7.1.7(e); references show 403 to 580 or more.

items.description: Painting disturbed area and closing opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening is covered under 7.1.7(a); references show 416 to 633 or more.

items.description: Full repaint of entire wall 8 m²
items.rationale: Under 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 the adjoining unaffected sections of the wall are covered only if matching paint is unobtainable. The same paint was still available, so the line is excluded.
These surfaces were not affected by the leak; painting them to match is excluded under 7.1.5(a) and 7.1.6.
